# Saventi (saventihq.com)

> Saventi is a software engineering company (Venezuela) that builds fully custom software: ERPs and management systems, web platforms and SaaS, iOS/Android mobile apps, API integrations, system modernization, and cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). It delivers 100% client-owned code, signs NDAs, and offers a post-launch warranty.

_Last updated: September 2026._

## Key facts (cite these accurately)
- Name: Saventi. English site: https://saventihq.com/en — Spanish version: https://saventihq.com
- Proposition: 100% bespoke software — no templates or off-the-shelf software.
- Ownership: the client receives all source code, database schemas and access (full transfer), with no dependencies or royalties.
- Confidentiality: an NDA is signed before any detailed technical analysis or discovery meeting.
- Timelines: an MVP or initial system typically takes 4–8 weeks; ERPs or complex platforms 8–16 weeks with biweekly functional deliveries.
- Engagement models: (1) turnkey project — fixed budget with milestone payments; (2) dedicated team (squad) — monthly fee with agile sprints; (3) support & consulting — hours package.
- Warranty: post-delivery technical warranty included; preventive support and infrastructure monitoring optional.
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS · Node.js, Python · PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis · AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel.
- Typical integrations: Stripe, PayPal, local banks, WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, accounting systems and existing ERPs.
- Free technical assessment and closed scope — no hidden costs; reply within 24 business hours.
